image.source: public-domain aerial photograph (USDA NAIP, 2006, via Wikimedia Commons); not taken by the prototype

differences.what: the same picture stored twice (a new key each time, as the system does)
the picture with one pixel value changed by one, stored again (a new key, as the system does)
one pixel value changed, SAME key and nonce (never done by the system): only that value differs

wrong_key.what: decryption with a key that differs in ONE bit
